text.tspan: AI harnesses through agentgateway with agw-token
Employee laptops (rolled out and configured by MDM)
Token store: Secret Service, else 0600 file
customer-operated in the EU (Cloud Run or Kubernetes)
1. Verify ID token: signature via provider JWKS,
2. Authorize: Entra tenant ID or Google hd domain,
4. Log every request against the verified user
5. Route the model name to a provider using the
(one or more, as configured on the gateway)
Laptops hold no AI vendor, GCP, AWS or
Azure API keys. The only credential they
carry is the employee's short-lived OIDC
ID token. Cloud credentials exist only on
the gateway. Prompts stay in the regions
the gateway and models are deployed in.
